units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>פרת א׳ של וכ׳</he> the Euphrates is the originator (ultimate source) of the rivers (mentioned <cite ref="Genesis 2:10">Gen. II, 10</cite> sq.).—Pl. m. <cite ref="A00598"><he>אַוְותֶּנְטִין</he></cite>. Y’lamd. to Num.
